title: Generated sql.gleam rewraps clear_reminder_for_sender's comment with no matching .sql source change in the diff
detail: A Squirrel-generated file's comment rewrapped for a query whose .sql source is absent from the diff. Implies hand-editing of generated code or an uncommitted source tweak; the next run_squirrel.sh reverts it, creating churn.
recommended_fix: Either commit the matching clear_reminder_for_sender.sql rewrap so source and generated file agree, or revert the sql.gleam rewrap to match the unchanged source.
